cases.prompt: Take interview.mp4 and cut the filler words and long pauses. Keep it under a minute.
pass_when: An MP4 is delivered and decodes fully
Every kept range traces to transcript times
Spoken output matches captions or transcript without chopped words at sampled cuts
The report separates rendered, checked, reviewed and approved

cases.prompt: Make a captioned vertical clip of the best 30 seconds from talk.mp4 for Reels.
pass_when: Output is 1080x1920 and picture coverage is 1.0
The speaker stays in frame in sampled frames
Burned captions stay within two lines and clear of the bottom 25%
Low-confidence words are corrected or reported

cases.prompt: Record a 45-second walkthrough of the app at this URL showing one task from start to finish.
pass_when: The recording is of the real interface
A pointer is visible in sampled frames
The final state is held long enough to read
The browser-workflow check and encode check are reported separately

cases.prompt: The caption at 00:18 is wrong and the scene at 00:30 is too long. Fix just those.
pass_when: Only the affected scenes re-render, shown by reused_scenes
Captions are regenerated for changed timing
Approved scenes are unchanged

cases.prompt: This render came out with black bars, silence at the end and captions out of sync. Sort it out.
cases.input: A faulty export with its project
pass_when: verify --qc is run before and after
Each fault is traced to a cause
The source and last usable output are preserved
Remaining limits are stated

cases.prompt: The generation job timed out after I paid for it. Just submit it again.
pass_when: The same job is queried before any new submission, or the uncertainty is reported
No new paid call is made without authorization

should_trigger: cut the ums out of interview.mov
turn this podcast into three Shorts
make my landscape video vertical for TikTok
this render failed, can you fix it
write me a storyboard for a product launch video
should_not_trigger: fix the autoplay bug in our video element
what's a good camera for vlogging
